Lessons from the Week 2 run

    Loop step 4, replace the "type last field, click Save day" tip:
    The skill says clicking Save day right after typing saves the last field. That's wrong here.
    Replace it with: type one extra digit, press Backspace, wait 3 seconds, then continue. Verify by leaving and returning.
    Table cells with no refs: The skill says to flag them for the user to enter by hand. That's wrong. Click a cell, press Enter, type into the new textbox, press Enter. Fill in row order, and wait 3 seconds before leaving.
    Save day: It has to be clicked only after the values are confirmed to stick, since it locks the day. Check it by leaving the day and returning first.
    Reporting: Per-field totals aren't in the page text for number fields. Use a screenshot, and for table days look for the "Day is complete" banner.
